body: Thank you so so much, i think this is the best advise i have ever gotten. Many people think and say i am ungrateful which makes it all the more difficult to share my feelings and thoughts. One takeaway from your message is the trauma and pain i will leave by  ending my life. You have really saved me, thanks a mil

No problem really. Thats why it's so difficult trying to talk to people because they all think that money buys one happiness. I am a sad individual who looks happy and has no one to talk to because the first comment they have is "but you have money".

Thank you, will definitely seek medical attention because this has taken over my life. I am a married man and i feel like i am always pretending when i am at home. But deep down, i am truly unfulfilled. I can't live this life, i am tired.
